nodes.author: jubaer0712
nodes.text: The #virus seems to be spreading rapidly, & no one knows exactly how it’s contracted, but many are worried about the connection to animal consumption. After the devastation of #Covid, can we really afford another deadly outbreak? #StopChina 2/4

nodes.author: jubaer0712
nodes.text: With every new health crisis, the fear of another pandemic grows. #HMPV may be even more dangerous if it spreads unchecked, and the possibility that it’s tied to unsafe animal consumption adds another layer of concern. Are we ready for this? 3/4

nodes.author: jubaer0712
nodes.text: The world can’t afford to ignore another viral threat from China, especially after the devastation of # COVID-19. We must demand better controls on animal consumption & stricter regulations to prevent viruses like #HMPV from causing another global disaster. 4/4
